title: console(marketplace): the package page offers the install-mode choice (managed / unmanaged) the install door takes since ADR-0131 D6 S2 — the objectui stage S4 of objectstack-ai/objectstack#15213
body:
Filing gate **④**, a coordination node: the per-layer child of objectstack-ai/objectstack#15213 (the install modes of ADR-0131 D6), whose stage plan (`6108175106`, S4) names this card: "the objectui marketplace choice, a companion card the seat files". The backend stages have landed; this is the only stage left.

Filed by `domain:spec` seat 2 (objectstack seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#18549) · `os-justin` · session `session_01BRQ9Mp1yH7R1az6MaUM18H`. ⛔ Not a claim. Lane and grade are objectui triage's.

**Reader who acts:** the objectui seat triage routes it to (the console marketplace surface, `packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/`), in one PR.

## What the backend serves today (objectstack `main` `c9b5b24b0`)

- A package manifest may declare `installModes`: `managed` and/or `unmanaged`; absent reads `['managed']` (PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#22916, `c7d60378f0`).
- The install door (`POST /api/v1/marketplace/install-local`, `packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts`, header near `:48`–`:72`) takes `installMode: 'managed' | 'unmanaged'`; absent means `managed`.
  - `unmanaged` copies the package's metadata once into a new writable base: the environment's own metadata, editable, never upgraded. The answer's `strippedLocks` names every protection lock dropped, with the package's reason (PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#23075).
  - Refusals, each before any write: `422 INSTALL_MODE_NOT_PERMITTED` (a mode the package does not permit); `409 UNMANAGED_INSTALL_WALLED_POSTURE` (an unmanaged copy on a deployment whose requested tenancy posture walls organizations); `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` (a managed install while an unmanaged copy holds the namespace, naming the base).
- `os package install --install-mode` is the CLI half; the authoring page is `content/docs/deployment/install-modes.mdx` (PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#23108).

## Wanted

The console's package page (`MarketplacePackagePage.tsx`) offers the choice where the package permits more than one mode, sends `installMode` on the install, shows `strippedLocks` after an unmanaged copy, and shows each refusal's own message. A package that permits only `managed` shows no choice. ⛔ The console invents no mode rule of its own: what is permitted is the manifest's `installModes` and the door's answer.

## Done when

objectstack-ai/objectstack#15213's last stage is met: "`os install` and the marketplace surfaces expose the choice". That card is `pm:blocked` on this one and closes when this lands.
